# Style Guide

The canonical authoring rules for this repository.

## Plain language

- Put the bottom line first.
- Keep a sentence to 25 words or fewer.
- Keep a step in a procedure to 20 words or fewer.
- Use the active voice. Say who does what.
- Use one word for one meaning.
- Name the real item. Do not write a vague word in its place.

## Diagrams

Draw a flow as a Mermaid diagram. Write one sentence before the diagram that says what it shows.
Keep a diagram to about twelve nodes.
